Our mission

A personal approach

Your goals.
Our starting point.

At Smartway Finance, we put your needs first. As a specialist finance broker, we guide you from enquiry to settlement with tailored loan solutions across asset finance, vehicle loans and business lending.

We make the process clear and efficient, working with a broad panel of lenders to help you access competitive lending options suited to your circumstances. Most importantly, we carefully manage your application to minimise unnecessary credit enquiries and support informed lending decisions.

What we stand for

Our core values.

Good finance starts with people
who put you first.

Transparency

Honest guidance, transparent communication, and support you can trust. We tell you what you need to hear, not what you want to hear.

Personalised Service

Every client is different. We take the time to understand your unique situation and tailor our approach accordingly.

Expert Knowledge

Fast & Simple

The team

Meet Cara & Alice.

We're the faces behind Smartway Finance, and while we love helping our clients achieve their goals, there's a lot more to us than finance.

Co-Directors

Cara Rogers & Alice Blay

Directors, Smartway Finance

Between us, we bring over a decade of finance experience and have helped thousands of Australians achieve their goals. Alice's expertise was recognised nationally when she was awarded NSW Broker of the Year 2024.

While we're proud of our experience, what matters most to us is building genuine relationships and being there for our clients whenever they need us. At the end of the day, we're just two people who love what we do and believe in real relationships with the people we help.

Director & Senior Finance Broker

Cara Rogers

FBAA Member · ACL #566769

Cara is a passionate foodie with a chef's background who loves discovering new restaurants, cooking, and bringing people together over great food. She enjoys spending time with her partner, family, and friends and is usually the first to organise a catch-up, celebration, or social event.

At home, she's kept busy by her two miniature Dachshunds and a very spoiled Ragdoll cat, who definitely run the household.

Talk to our team

Director & Senior Finance Broker

Alice Blay

NSW Broker of the Year 2024 · FBAA Member · ACL #566769

Originally from Sydney, Alice is a proud wife and mother to a recently arrived baby boy, who has quickly become the boss of the household. When she's not helping clients, you'll often find her in the garden (with varying levels of success) or whale watching along the coast.

She gets far too excited whenever she spots a splash on the horizon — and her clients get that same energy every single day.
